subject: SDLC orchestration: credential handback, pipeline run logs, and executive summary
messages:
From: Tim Ho <t.ho@northbridge.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2027-05-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: orchestration & credential handback evidence for CAIQ review

Jordan —

Thanks for taking the intake call this morning. For the CAIQ intake we need a compact bundle showing how you hand back short-lived CI credentials after runs, details of keystore rotation in the last 90 days, and representative CI orchestration logs for a typical deploy (including job start/end timestamps and the identity that executed the job). Can you provide:

- A redacted keystore rotation manifest (names redacted OK)
- CI pipeline run log for a recent production deployment (stderr/stdout excerpts ok)
- The orchestration playbook or runbook describing the handback process

We prefer a single reply with attachments and a one-paragraph executive summary describing internal controls and owners. Tight timeline — assessor packet due EOD tomorrow.

Appreciate it,
Tim
Northbridge Compliance

Subject: Re: Request: orchestration & credential handback evidence for CAIQ review

Tim —

Thanks — we can get you a concise bundle. Attaching a short executive summary and redacted artifacts in my next message after coordinating with engineering. Quick summary up front:

- Owner: CI/CD platform team (Irene Choi, eng lead)
- Mechanism: ephemeral CI service tokens issued by internal token broker; post-job handback via automated revoke API; keystore rotations are performed quarterly with HSM backing and recorded in an auditable manifest.
- Evidence we'll attach: redacted rotation manifest, a representative pipeline run log (truncated), and the orchestration playbook.

I'll loop in Irene and Lauren to pull the exact files and confirm timestamps. Expect attachments within 2–3 hours.

Jordan Blake
Head of Platform GTM (acting)
Redwood Inference

Irene / Marissa —

Can you pull the artifacts Tim requested and redact PII/names? Requirements below. Need this assembled as attachments plus a 3–4 sentence exec summary I can send to the assessor. Deadline EOD tomorrow (2027-05-24). Specific asks:

1) Keystore rotation manifest (last rotation event within 90 days) — redact absolute key material; indicate rotation timestamp, operator identity (role not personal email), and KMS/HSM reference.
2) CI pipeline run log: one representative production deploy run (include job start/end, job id, runner identity, artifact checksum step, and post-job revoke call). Truncate long logs; include the sequence of steps and timestamps.
3) Orchestration playbook: the runbook page describing the ephemeral token issuance and handback / revoke flow.

Also please include any Jira ticket ids or change-approval reference that tie the rotation to a change window. If any of these are sensitive, redaction ok — note what was redacted.

Thanks — Jordan

Executive summary (2 sentences):
Redwood's CI/CD platform issues ephemeral service tokens for every production job via an internal token broker. Redactions: real key material and user emails replaced with roles or aliases; checksums presented without full artifact paths.
